code: generation <- gene_drop_generation(   hap1 = base_haplotypes$hap1,   hap2 = base_haplotypes$hap2,   sire = c(1, 2, 1, 4),   dam = c(3, 4, 2, 1),   map = map,   seed = 123,   engine = "R" )  generation$genotype ##      [,1] [,2] [,3] [,4] ## [1,]    1    0    0    1 ## [2,]    0    0    2    0 ## [3,]    1    0    1    0 ## [4,]    1    1    1    0 generation$hap1 ##      [,1] [,2] [,3] [,4] ## [1,]    0    0    0    0 ## [2,]    0    0    1    0 ## [3,]    0    0    0    0 ## [4,]    0    0    0    0 generation$hap2 ##      [,1] [,2] [,3] [,4] ## [1,]    1    0    0    1 ## [2,]    0    0    1    0 ## [3,]    1    0    1    0 ## [4,]    1    1    1    0 engines <- lapply(c("R", "C++", "Fortran"), function(engine) {   gene_drop_generation(     base_haplotypes$hap1,     base_haplotypes$hap2,     sire = c(1, 2, 1, 4),     dam = c(3, 4, 2, 1),     map = map,     seed = 456,     engine = engine   ) })  identical(engines[[1]]$genotype, engines[[2]]$genotype) ## [1] TRUE identical(engines[[1]]$genotype, engines[[3]]$genotype) ## [1] TRUE

title: Simple Multi-Generational Pedigree Simulation
text: gene_drop_generation() simulates recombination marker inheritance one generation parental haplotypes sire/dam row indices. call can use supported engine: R handles validation, random-event generation, user-facing interface. C++ Fortran apply deterministic marker-level inheritance loop. seed, engines tested produce identical outputs. Implementation files: R wrapper validation C++ implementation Fortran implementation Native routine registration Cross-engine tests simple single-chromosome teaching example illustrates compiled-code integration R package, complete production breeding simulator. See gene-dropping article detail.
code: library(qgsim)  set.seed(1) hap1 <- matrix(sample(0:1, 10 * 20, replace = TRUE), nrow = 10) hap2 <- matrix(sample(0:1, 10 * 20, replace = TRUE), nrow = 10) map <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 20)  sire <- c(1, 2, 3, 4) dam <- c(5, 6, 7, 8)  gr <- gene_drop_generation(   hap1 = hap1,   hap2 = hap2,   sire = sire,   dam = dam,   map = map,   seed = 123,   engine = "C++" )  dim(gr$genotype) gr_r <- gene_drop_generation(..., engine = "R") gr_cpp <- gene_drop_generation(..., engine = "C++") gr_fortran <- gene_drop_generation(..., engine = "Fortran")
